utilization: Each run reserved eight GPUs on one host and launched eight training processes, one per GPU. Downloads, model loading, rank-0-only checkpoint/serving checks and completed worker queues include idle GPU intervals.

protocol.evaluation: Early runs score four rows; later runs cover all eight training rows. Current media probes score each row in both choice orders (16 evaluations) to match training-time option permutation. Each check records its evaluation size and choice-order coverage.
protocol.serving: Reloaded checkpoint through the public Python API and FastAPI ASGI HTTP routes, including repeated valid requests, health, model listing and invalid-request rejection.

scope: Official pretrained weights, short SFT and RLCR runs, checkpoint reload, Python and HTTP serving. Synthetic optimization fixtures; no task-quality or generalization claim.
